_om: Dommeren in English (Judgey, rusj.no/en/judgey/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. «Dommeren» is the round's judge; «svarkort» are the answer cards in each hand; «Fest» is the party pack behind the 18+ question. The cards are in data.en/kort.json, written for the UK.
Et kort har et tomt felt. Alle velger i: A card has a blank. Everyone secretly picks the funniest answer from their own hand – and the judge chooses the best.
Dommeren leser kortet med det tomme felt: The judge reads the card with the blank out loud. Everyone takes a turn as judge.
Mobilen går rundt. Hver av dere ser bare: The phone goes round. Each of you only sees your own five answer cards and picks the one that fits best – or worst.
Dommeren leser alle setningene høyt og v: The judge reads every sentence out loud and picks the best. Whoever played that card gets the point. First to the target wins.
Dommeren vet ikke hvem som la hvilket ko: The judge doesn’t know who played which card. Don’t give yourself away!
Etter hver runde fyller alle opp til fem: After each round, everyone tops up to five cards again.
«Fest» har litt drøyere humor og er bare: ‘Party’ has cheekier humour and is for adults only (18+).
Trykket feil kort? «Angre» gir det tilba: Tapped the wrong card? ‘Undo’ gives it back before the judge has seen anything.
Kjenner noen kortet fra før? Trykk «Bytt: Someone already knows the card? Tap ‘New card’ before the phone goes round.
Quick – a good start to the evening.
A long battle. Lots of judges tonight.
{navn} leser kortet høyt. Så går mobilen: {navn} reads the card out loud. Then the phone goes round, and everyone else secretly picks an answer.
Alle har valgt! Gi mobilen til dommeren: Everyone has chosen! Pass the phone to the judge
Dommeren leser alle svarene høyt: The judge reads every answer out loud
De andre ser bort mens du velger: Everyone else looks away while you choose
Les alle høyt – og velg den beste: Read them all out – then pick the best
Well done! The judges have spoken.
Ingen runder ble kåret. Neste gang går d: No rounds were decided. Better luck next time!
«{pakke}» har litt drøyere humor og er b: ‘{pakke}’ has cheekier humour and is for adults only.
Angret – poenget til {navn} er tatt tilb: Undone – {navn}’s point has been taken back
Dere går rett til kåringen. Den med fles: You’ll go straight to the results. Whoever has the most points wins.
